comparison.objective: Load dumbbell plates and secure them with collars; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial plate/collar insertion on two bar ends versus counterhold an adjustment screw while tightening a jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Both plates home with outside collars locked versus precise opening retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both involve locking hardware, but collar installation does not test preservation of an adjustable setting under reaction torque.
